library(ConversationAlign)
library(mockery)
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(rstatix)


#keep only messages > 1500 texts
messages_shortlist <- keep(messages, ~ nrow(.x) > 1500)
dimensions_list <- c("3", "5", "15", "17", "19") #which affective dimensions do you want? consult list
#dimensions_list <- c("1", "3")

full_alignment_list <- list()


#run the custom alignment wrapper across all messages in the data frame
#this loop runs along alignment dimensions, not conversations
#conversations are processed in parallel using furrr for computational optimization
for (i in seq_along(dimensions_list)) {
  
  alignment_values <- messages_shortlist %>%
    future_map(~ calculate_alignment(data = .x, variable = dimensions_list[i], speaker_id = "Shawn Wang"))
  
  full_alignment_list <- append(full_alignment_list, alignment_values)
  
  
}


#join all results together
alignment_df <- map_dfr(full_alignment_list, rbind)
alignment_df_wide <- alignment_df %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = convo_num,
              names_from = Dimension,
              values_from = c(AUC_raw_Immediate:TurnCorr_Lag2))



#computing correlation matrix
behavioral_vars <- c("dbi",
                     "word_ratio_log", "end_ratio_log", "init_ratio_log", "rt_ratio_mean_log",
                     "message_ratio_log", "rt_ratio_median_log")
lm_df <- merge(dbi_result, alignment_df_wide, by = "convo_num", all.y = TRUE)
corr_df <- lm_df %>%
  select(-convo_num, -other_recipient)
alignment_vars <- corr_df %>% 
  select(starts_with("AUC_scaled") | starts_with("TurnCorr")) %>% 
  colnames()
corr_result <- rcorr(as.matrix(corr_df))
corr_p <- as.data.frame(corr_result$P)
corr_r <- as.data.frame(corr_result$r)

# Get upper triangle of the correlation matrix
get_upper_tri <- function(cormat){
    cormat[lower.tri(cormat)]<- NA
    return(cormat)
}

cormat_p <- corr_result$P
cormat_p_melt <- melt(cormat_p, na.rm = TRUE)
names(cormat_p_melt)[3] <- "p_value"

cormat_r <- corr_result$r
cormat_r_melt <- melt(cormat_r, na.rm = TRUE)
names(cormat_r_melt)[3] <- "correlation"

full_cormat <- merge(cormat_r_melt, cormat_p_melt, by = c("Var1", "Var2"))


filtered_cormat <- full_cormat %>%
  filter(Var1 %in% behavioral_vars & Var2 %in% alignment_vars)


#visualize full correlation matrix
ggplot(data = filtered_cormat, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = ifelse(p_value < .05, correlation, NA)))+
 geom_tile(color = "black") + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
   midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1, 1), space = "Lab", 
   name="Correlation") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, 
    size = 4, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))+
 coord_fixed()

#ggsave("correlation_plot.png", plot = get_last_plot())



#visualize only the DBI plot
filtered_cormat %>%
  filter(Var1 == "dbi") %>%
  ggplot(aes(Var2, Var1, fill = ifelse(p_value < .05, correlation, NA)))+
 geom_tile(color = "black") + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
   midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1, 1), space = "Lab", 
   name="Correlation") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 65, vjust = 1, 
    size = 4, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))+
 coord_fixed()

ggsave("correlation_plot_onlyDBI.png", plot = get_last_plot())

#which correlations are significant in tabular format?
corr_p_filter <- filtered_cormat %>%
  filter(p_value < .05)
